sonnet.problem: The fill in the blank hangs on the hard word 'defiled'. Nothing on any earlier card lets the baker reason their way to it. The baker would be guessing Paul's wording, and 'healed' is an obviously off answer.
sonnet.rule: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about verse 8 (food does not bring us closer to God) before any story card has told verse 8. Card 5 tells it afterward and repeats the fact the card just revealed.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
